name: account-switch
description: Switch between Claude subscription accounts. In a terminal: /account switches inside the running session. In Claude Desktop: one band above the prompt with the session's status and, on Windows, the plan limits and an account picker (a switch restarts the app)

cache_ttl.title: Prompt-cache TTL
cache_ttl.description: How long your main conversation's prompt cache lives: 1h or 5m (anything else counts as 1h). The desktop band marks the cache cold after this much idle time: 1h on a Claude subscription within plan usage, 5m with pay-as-you-go API billing, a cloud provider or usage credits.
